nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; assigned from msg.sender in the Owned constructor and changed by transferOwnership/acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address staged by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string set to LUCK in the constructor.
Public token name string set to Luck in the constructor.
Public token decimals set to 18 in the constructor.
Internal total supply value minted to the owner at construction.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; mutated by approve and approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used for ownership checks, balance keys and allowance keys.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Completes ownership handover when called by newOwner.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath sub.
Returns the balance of the supplied tokenOwner.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using SafeMath.
Sets an allowance for spender from msg.sender with no double-spend check.
Moves tokens from a from account to a to account and decrements the caller allowance.
Returns the remaining allowance of a spender for a tokenOwner.
Sets allowance then performs an external receiveApproval call on the spender contract.
Payable fallback that always reverts, refusing plain ETH.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract to sweep tokens.
Owned constructor that assigns owner from msg.sender.
LUCK constructor that sets metadata and mints the fixed supply to the owner.
External call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with attacker-controlled spender and data.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied contract address.
Unchecked exponentiation and multiplication 6000000000 * 10**uint(decimals) computing the supply.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership, written into newOwner.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf used to index balances.
Parameter to of transfer, recipient of tokens.
Parameter tokens of transfer, amount debited from msg.sender.
Parameter spender of approve, allowance beneficiary.
Parameter from of transferFrom, source account debited by the caller.
Parameter to of transferFrom, destination account.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom, amount moved and debited from allowance.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance used to index allowed.
Parameter spender of allowance used to index allowed.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall, allowance holder and external call target.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall, allowance amount.
Parameter data of approveAndCall, opaque bytes forwarded to the spender contract.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token, arbitrary contract invoked.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token, amount requested from the external token.

edges.reason: owner state variable is assigned directly from the untrusted msg.sender in the Owned constructor, granting privileged control to the deployer.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before performing the ownership handover.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied _newOwner into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner back to address(0).
transfer debits and credits balances keyed by msg.sender.
approve records the allowance under msg.sender in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom consumes the allowance of the untrusted msg.sender acting as spender.
approveAndCall updates allowed[msg.sender][spender] before handing control to an external contract.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by onlyOwner requiring msg.sender == owner.
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval call after mutating allowance state.
the untrusted spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall during receiveApproval before allowance was consumed.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes transfer on the arbitrary tokenAddress contract.
the arbitrary token contract executes its own code and can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token while owner privileges are checked.
the LUCK constructor computes the fixed supply with unchecked exponentiation and multiplication.
the unchecked arithmetic result is stored into the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf returns a value read from the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
approve writes the requested amount into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping after a SafeMath sub check.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external receiveApproval call.
allowance returns a value read from the allowed mapping.
parameter _newOwner flows into the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership.
parameter tokenOwner is used to index balances in balanceOf.
parameter to is credited inside transfer.
parameter tokens is debited from msg.sender inside transfer.
parameter spender keys the allowed mapping in approve.
parameter from is debited inside transferFrom.
parameter to is credited inside transferFrom.
parameter tokens is removed from balances and allowance inside transferFrom.
parameter tokenOwner keys the allowed mapping in allowance.
parameter spender keys the allowed mapping in allowance.
parameter spender becomes both the allowance key and the external contract called in approveAndCall.
parameter tokens is stored in allowed before the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
parameter data is forwarded verbatim to the untrusted spender contract in approveAndCall.
parameter tokenAddress is cast to ERC20Interface and called inside transferAnyERC20Token.
parameter tokens is passed to the external transfer call inside transferAnyERC20Token.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only used to write the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership and has no independent semantic role.
tokenOwner is a pure index argument of balanceOf and carries no distinct security semantics.
the to address of transfer is only a destination key for the balances mapping.
the tokens amount of transfer is a local quantity validated by SafeMath sub.
spender is only a key of the allowed mapping written by approve.
from is only the debited account keyed in balances inside transferFrom.
to is only the credited account keyed in balances inside transferFrom.
tokens is the amount moved and deducted from allowance inside transferFrom.
tokenOwner is a pure lookup key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is a pure lookup key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is both the allowance key and the external contract target, so it belongs to the unsafe external call operation.
tokens is written to allowed before the external call and has no separate role.
data is opaque caller-controlled bytes forwarded straight into the external receiveApproval invocation.
tokenAddress is the arbitrary contract invoked by the unsafe external transfer call.
tokens is the amount passed into the external token transfer and depends on the called contract's behaviour.
